title: Whitley Strieber: chosen as a disclosure node because he was a horror writer
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Whitley Strieber: chosen as a disclosure node because he was a horror writer, about 1980s (Communion) at an unknown place, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Whitley Streber talks about this as well where he says I think they chose me as a communication node for disclosure

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about Whitley Strieber, a horror writer known for his 1980s book Communion, about his reported encounters with strange beings. Michels says Strieber believes that 'they' chose him as a communication node for disclosure, meaning a channel for slowly revealing a non-human presence to the public, and the story holds that a horror writer was picked on purpose.
